changelog:
alibabacloud-dns-resolve-diagnose-customer v0.0.1

- Initial public release of a read-only Alibaba Cloud DNS diagnostic tool for end users.
- Supports troubleshooting DNS issues (e.g. resolution failure, unreachable domains, NXDOMAIN) on Alibaba Cloud DNS, GTM, PrivateZone, and third-party DNS.
- Performs WHOIS lookup, recursive tracing, Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI config checks, and nationwide probing via boce to generate reports.
- Strict read-only guarantee: all create, update, delete, or modify operations are refused, with standard refusal responses and cannot be bypassed.
- Clear instructions on environment setup, parameter confirmation, authentication, and required RAM permissions.
summary: Alicloud DNS Diagnostic Skill (Read-Only). Diagnostic tool for domain unreachable, DNS resolution failure, DNS record not taking effect, NXDOMAIN, unknownhost, and other DNS-layer issues. Automatically performs WHOIS lookup, recursive tracing, OpenAPI config verification, and nationwide probing via boce to generate diagnostic reports. Covers Alibaba Cloud DNS, GTM, PrivateZone, and third-party DNS. This skill is read-only and will NOT execute any Create, Update, Delete, or other write operations. Triggers: "DNS resolution failed", "domain unreachable", "DNS not working", "NXDOMAIN", "domain ping failed", "DNS diagnose", "quick check", "快速检查", "DNS record check", "记录解析", "DNS resolution status", "解析状态", "check A/CNAME/MX/TXT record"
